reason: PicGo-Core is an image-uploading engine exposed through CLI and API, with clipboard support, configurable uploaders, server mode, and optional cloud authentication.

summaries.zh: PicGo-Core 是一个支持命令行和 API 的图片上传引擎，可从文件路径或剪贴板上传图片并管理上传器配置。
summaries.en: PicGo-Core is an image-uploading engine with CLI and API support for uploading images from file paths or the clipboard and managing uploader configurations.

capabilities: Uploads images from file paths or clipboard
Runs as a command-line tool or standalone server
Integrates with configurable image uploader services
Manages PicGo plugins and uploader configurations
Supports PicGo Cloud login and logout
